title: Recent advances in focal adhesion kinase (FAK)-targeting antitumor agents
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,20957-20984

The recent avances in the design and biological activity of FAK-targeting antitumor agents are summarized in this review with a focus on their chemical structures, antitumor effects, and clinical progress.
